findings.thesis: Reject the entry. Cognizant confirmed that it will report Q3 2026 results before the open on 2026-10-29. That is about five trading days after the Oct 22 research date, so the release falls inside the holding window. An overnight gap on the print can jump past the supplied stop, so the stop gives no protection against this event. The News and Event Agent found no material event against a long and missed this catalyst. The Scanner and Thesis agents raised only generic gap risk, not this dated event. The stock has also run about 18% over an 8-day winning streak into a binary event, which makes the setup extended. The last print was mixed: Q2 EPS of $1.37 missed the $1.38 consensus, and the stock rose on the outlook. The consensus analyst price target (about 66.34) sits below the entry area.
